challenge_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS challenges ( pubkey TEXT NOT NULL,  challenge TEXT NOT NULL,  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL )
challenge_schema.source:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS challenges (\
            pubkey TEXT NOT NULL, \
            challenge TEXT NOT NULL, \
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL\
        )

credential_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webauthn_credentials ( pubkey TEXT NOT NULL,  credential_id TEXT NOT NULL,  public_key TEXT NOT NULL,  counter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  prf_salt TEXT,  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL )
credential_schema.source:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webauthn_credentials (\
            pubkey TEXT NOT NULL, \
            credential_id TEXT NOT NULL, \
            public_key TEXT NOT NULL, \
            counter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, \
            prf_salt TEXT, \
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL\
        )

insert_credential.sql: INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (pubkey, credential_id, public_key, prf_salt, counter, created_at)  VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)
insert_credential.source:
INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (pubkey, credential_id, public_key, prf_salt, counter, created_at) \
             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)

lookup.sql: SELECT pubkey FROM webauthn_credentials WHERE credential_id = ?1 LIMIT 1
lookup.source: SELECT pubkey FROM webauthn_credentials WHERE credential_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

login_challenge.sql: SELECT 1 as ok FROM challenges  WHERE challenge = ?1 AND created_at > ?2 AND pubkey IN (?3, ?4)
login_challenge.source:
SELECT 1 as ok FROM challenges \
             WHERE challenge = ?1 AND created_at > ?2 AND pubkey IN (?3, ?4)

counter_update.sql: UPDATE webauthn_credentials SET counter = ?1 WHERE pubkey = ?2
counter_update.source: UPDATE webauthn_credentials SET counter = ?1 WHERE pubkey = ?2
